dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave parabolic curvature along the trailing edge, originating from the posterior insertion point and tapering toward the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the maximum vertical morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 40-degree upward slope relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Estimated 1.5:1 ratio of maximum pixel base width to maximum vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, large-radius convex curve extending from the blowhole region to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, thick rostrum displaying a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio and blunt termination.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Visible obtuse interior angle where the steep melon slope transitions into the dorsal surface of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple white linear depigmented striations on the lateral flank; small circular mark on the dorsal-lateral cranial surface near the blowhole region.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pale horizontal band extending along the lower lateral body region.
